verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a SaaS platform for company formation and compliance, so a documented public API is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never shows a public API that users or agents can call to drive the product. The pricing-page line 'Advanced API integrations' has no description and appears to mean integrations with third-party tools, not a Firstbase API, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs and llms.txt all returned 404.
